items.requirement: A clean checkout installs, builds, migrates repeatedly, atomically seeds, and starts independent API, Worker, dispatcher, and production UI processes.
OpenAPI 3.1, closed JSON, stable errors, pagination, idempotency, browser UI, seed, and verification snapshot match the published contract.
Multipart ranges, digests, resume, complete, abort, streaming assembly, file atomicity, replay, and cleanup preserve one exact media object.
Quarantine, scanner authority, frozen transcode profiles, rendition identity, lease fencing, and stale-worker rejection converge after crashes.
Rights revisions total 10,000 basis points; published Edition assets, rights revision, and canonical manifest remain immutable under concurrency.
Offers, purchase acceptance, fraud authority, payment uncertainty, License grant, refunds, replay, and provider ordering never create a partial or duplicate commercial fact.
Frozen fraud rules, reviewer leases, grant/revocation fences, and strongly consistent checks never permit premature or post-revocation access.
Frozen rights allocation, deterministic remainder, balanced immutable postings, refunds, close digest, and source lineage conserve every minor unit.
Two API/Worker processes, persistent idempotency, leased Work, fencing, response loss, retries, and SIGKILL recover without duplicate authority.
Transactional Events and Notifications keep gapless aggregate order, stable identity/body, sensitive-field exclusion, and unknown-ACK recovery.
The revealed RightsDispute, LicenseHold, and settled RoyaltyAdjustment migration, authority fences, UI, concurrency, and recovery preserve all V1 and closed facts.
All six exact pressure scenarios meet fixed throughput, latency, duration, resource, and post-load correctness requirements.
The project owns real unit, PostgreSQL integration, production Chromium E2E, multi-process concurrency, SIGKILL recovery, aggregate, and performance gates.
Codex explains authority, immutable revisions, failure boundaries, money conservation, recovery, and tradeoffs clearly.
Handoff reports actual commands, metrics, failures, residual risks, and unrun checks without overstating completion.
